title: Design System: Warhammer Survivors save editor

display.purpose: Main heading using the native sans stack.

world-title.purpose: Short English world names; the Latin font is bundled locally.

motion.name: button-hover
motion.purpose: Background transition on generation and preset buttons; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: download-ready
motion.purpose: Change only the prepared download background from download-ready to download-panel; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Applies to every element and pseudo-element when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce.

components.name: Generation button
components.description: Primary action; disable until the save is valid and any required version consent is accepted.
components.css: .ds-primary { font-family: "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; cursor: pointer; background: var(--green, #c1df91); color: #192418; border: 2px solid #e1f4bb; border-radius: 0; min-width: 202px; padding: 13px 20px; font-weight: 700; transition: background 0.16s ease-out; } .ds-primary:hover:enabled { background: #dbefba; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2d68d; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-primary { width: 100%; min-width: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary, .ds-preset, .ds-subtle, .ds-download { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; } }

components.name: Amount preset
components.description: Compact preset for assigning the same target to both worlds.
components.css: .ds-preset { font-family: "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid #7a836e; background: #263129; color: #eef3df; padding: 7px 15px; border-radius: 0; font-size: 13px; transition: background 0.16s ease-out; } .ds-preset:hover:enabled { background: #3b4c36; } .ds-preset:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2d68d; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-preset:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-preset { padding: 9px 16px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary, .ds-preset, .ds-subtle, .ds-download { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; } }

components.name: Clear preset
components.description: Underlined clear action with the same keyboard and disabled behavior as presets.
components.css: .ds-subtle { font-family: "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid #7a836e; background: #263129; color: #eef3df; padding: 7px 15px; border-radius: 0; font-size: 13px; transition: background 0.16s ease-out; background: transparent; border-color: transparent; color: #d4d5ca; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-subtle:hover:enabled { background: #3b4c36; } .ds-subtle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2d68d; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-subtle:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-subtle { padding: 9px 16px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary, .ds-preset, .ds-subtle, .ds-download { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; } }

components.name: File selection
components.description: Visible brass label around a native file input; its focus outline covers the label.
components.html: <label class="ds-file">選擇 .sav 檔案<input type="file" accept=".sav,application/json" aria-label="選擇存檔" /></label>
components.css: .ds-file { font-family: "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid #d2b981; background: #34362c; color: #f6e2b5; padding: 11px 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-file:hover { background: #4b4735; } .ds-file:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #f2d68d; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-file input { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-file { width: 100%; } }

components.name: Amount field
components.description: Monospaced numeric target with an associated label; aria-invalid applies the coral error border.
components.html: 可設 0～1,000,000,000。
components.css: .ds-amount-label { font-family: "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink, #f3ead7); } .ds-amount-label span { color: #c1c6be; font-size: 12px; } .ds-amount { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid #6e7c7e; border-bottom: 3px solid #6e7c7e; border-radius: 0; background: #0d171e; color: #fff1d1; padding: 12px 14px; font: 600 20px/1.5 ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; caret-color: var(--gold, #d5b36c); } .ds-amount::placeholder { color: #aeb8bb; font: 400 16px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-amount:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2d68d; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-amount[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--error, #ffb7a9); } .ds-amount:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-amount-help { font-family: "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; color: #b9c1bc; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 14px; }

components.name: 40K world panel
components.description: Square world surface with a stepped coin and tabular current balance.
components.html:
WARHAMMER 40,000

遙遠未來的戰備金庫

目前金額1,000,000
components.css: .ds-world { font-family: "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; background: #192c38; border: 1px solid #4b6472; padding: 20px; min-width: 0; color: var(--ink, #f3ead7); } .ds-world-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: #a8cee2; font: 9px/1.8 "Press Start 2P", monospace; } .ds-world-hint { color: #a8cee2; font-size: 12px; margin: 7px 0 20px; } .ds-balance { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; border-top: 1px solid #586257; padding-top: 14px; margin-bottom: 20px; color: #d3d5cb; font-size: 13px; } .ds-balance strong { color: var(--ink, #f3ead7); font: 600 21px/1.4 ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-coin { display: block; width: 15px; height: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; background: #d8ac40; border: 3px solid #f9d67a; border-right-color: #987024; clip-path: polygon(3px 0, 12px 0, 12px 3px, 15px 3px, 15px 15px, 12px 15px, 12px 18px, 3px 18px, 3px 15px, 0 15px, 0 3px, 3px 3px); } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-world { padding: 16px; } .ds-world-heading { font-size: 7px; } } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-world-heading { font-size: 9px; } .ds-world-hint { margin-bottom: 15px; } .ds-balance { margin-bottom: 16px; } }

components.name: Prepared download
components.description: A real named download link; the application moves focus here after rendering.
components.html: 下載 SaveDataUnity.patched.sav ↓
components.css: .ds-download { font-family: "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; color: #e2f2cc; background: #2c402a; padding: 15px 18px; margin-top: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--green, #c1df91); overflow-wrap: anywhere; text-underline-offset: 5px; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; animation: ds-ready 0.35s ease-out; } .ds-download:hover { color: #fff0cb; } .ds-download:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2d68d; outline-offset: 5px; } @keyframes ds-ready { from { background-color: #52643a; } to { background-color: #2c402a; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary, .ds-preset, .ds-subtle, .ds-download { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; } }

components.name: Unverified version consent
components.description: Amber warning with a native checkbox; acknowledgment is required before generation.
components.html: 此版本尚未實機驗證。
components.css: .ds-warning { font-family: "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; border: 1px solid #ab8a4d; background: #37301f; padding: 16px; margin-top: 20px; color: #f2d89d; font-size: 14px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-warning p { margin: 0; } .ds-warning label { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; margin-top: 12px; } .ds-warning input { width: 20px; height: 20px; accent-color: var(--gold, #d5b36c); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-warning input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2d68d; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Source navigation link
components.description: Underlined source link beside the masthead brand.
components.css: .ds-source { font-family: "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--gold, #d5b36c); font-size: 14px; white-space: nowrap; text-underline-offset: 5px; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; } .ds-source:hover { color: #fff0cb; } .ds-source:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2d68d; outline-offset: 5px; } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-source { font-size: 12px; } }

narrative.overview: Dark iron and stone surfaces, square brass edges, and crisp game pixels frame a readable local save editor. Blue steel identifies 40K; ochre stone identifies Age of Sigmar. Tonal surfaces and solid borders carry depth without shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Original app-icon pixels and short English pixel labels
Square material edges and flat tonal surfaces
Readable Chinese instructions and tabular amounts
Responsive stacking with visible focus and recovery

rules.name: The Named World Rule
rules.body: Pair each world color with its written name and field label; color alone never identifies a currency or an error.

rules.name: The Readable Instructions Rule
rules.body: Use native sans for Chinese instructions and reserve Press Start 2P for short English labels and numbered steps.

rules.name: The Flat Material Rule
rules.body: Use tonal separation and solid edges; keyboard focus is a visible outline.

dos: Do preserve crisp app-icon pixels and the two written world identities.
Do use tabular numbers and wrapping filenames.
Do preserve visible focus, readable errors, and responsive access to controls.
donts: Do not add decorative faction insignia.
Do not add shadows, rounded cards, or form-obscuring overlays.
Do not use pixel lettering for long Chinese instructions.
Do not add network-loaded design assets or imply that format checks verify a device build.
